pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark regions with softened, smooth edge gradients. Patches on the dorsal and mid-lateral regions are larger and more distinct, while those on the posterior rump are significantly smaller and more fragmented.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous light-toned negative space forming a network of interstitial pathways. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial. Path thickness is narrow and uniform on the upper flank, becoming wider and less regular toward the lower posterior.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette visible along the dorsal neck line, characterized by short, dark hair projections.
